item.title: US urges UN member states to stop backing Russia's 'deplorable' war on Ukraine
item.description: Deputy UN envoy Tammy Bruce singles out China as the "decisive enabler" of the Russian war machine, a claim Beijing has rejected as "unacceptable".

item.title: Mexico's Sheinbaum considers legal action after Musk links her to drug cartels
item.description: Sheinbaum's comments come after Elon Musk, without providing evidence, claimed she was "saying what her cartel bosses tell her to say."

item.title: Trump declares 'Golden Age of America' in first State of the Union of second term
item.description: In the longest speech ever, President Donald Trump touts a 'historic' economic surge and border closure, whilst claiming credit for ending the war in Gaza despite continued Israeli attacks.

item.title: Turkish F-16 crash in Balikesir: Pilot Major Ibrahim Bolat martyred
item.description: Contact lost shortly after midnight; investigation launched into crash near Naifli village.

item.title: Trump prefers diplomacy with Iran, but vows Tehran will 'never' obtain nukes
item.description: In his first State of the Union address of his second term, President Trump expressed his inclination for a diplomatic resolution to the Iranian nuclear crisis.

item.title: 'You have killed Americans!': US lawmaker shouts at Trump during State of the Union address
item.description: President Trump and Rep Ilhan Omar trade sharp accusations over immigration enforcement during a heated moment in Congress.

item.title: Somalia’s spy agency kills 23 Al Shabab members in anti-terror operations
item.description: Somalia’s National Intelligence and Security Agency says the militants were plotting imminent attacks in Hirshabelle state.

item.title: UN Security Council demands immediate ceasefire in Sudan, condemns attacks on civilians
item.description: Council members express deep concern over escalating violence in Kordofan and Darfur, condemn RSF assaults and drone strikes on humanitarian targets, and reaffirm Sudan’s sovereignty while urging a Sudanese-led path to peace.

item.title: New Zealand imposes travel bans on high-ranking Iranian officials over alleged rights violations
item.description: New Zealand joins Australia, the US, the UK, Canada and the European Union in imposing sanctions on Iran.
